description.value: Morrison Cafe is a locally owned cafe, kitchen, and bar in the Ocean Park neighbourhood of Surrey, serving breakfast, lunch, and dinner with a strong emphasis on fresh, locally sourced ingredients delivered daily. The menu spans classic breakfast fare through full dinner entrées including Thai green chicken curry, wild sockeye salmon, and weekly themed nights such as Burger & Beer Monday and Fish & Chips on Fridays and Saturdays. A second location operates in White Rock's Five Corners area, and online ordering is available through the website as well as Skip, Uber Eats, and DoorDash.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack at 33m; rack (covered) at 94m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is the Ocean Park–Surrey location of Morrison Cafe at 12855 16 Avenue, Surrey, BC V4A 1N5, matching the OSM address and phone (604)531-3636. The site confirms active online ordering via Skip, Uber Eats, and Doordash, establishing takeout as true. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, water refill, or any cycling-specific amenity appears anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so all those fields are null. OSM lists the community as 'Tsawwassen' but the address is unambiguously Surrey, BC (Ocean Park neighbourhood), and OSM opening hours differ from the website's current posted hours.
concerns: OSM community field is 'Tsawwassen' but the address (12855 16 Avenue, Surrey, BC V4A 1N5) places this business in Ocean Park, Surrey — not Tsawwassen/Delta. The OSM community tag appears incorrect.
OSM opening_hours (Su-Th 08:30-15:00; Fr-Sa 08:30-20:00) differ from the hours currently posted on the website for the Ocean Park location. Website hours appear more current.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating cafe with confirmed address, phone, website, and online ordering. Straightforwardly useful to touring cyclists passing through the Surrey/White Rock area.
enrichment_extras.notes: This is a two-location business; the OSM record corresponds to the Ocean Park–Surrey location. The Five Corners–White Rock location (15223 Pacific Ave Unit #1, White Rock, BC) may warrant a separate OSM/directory entry.
